name: Reload the original potion Light expire

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original potion inventory survey')
 print('PotionLight camera first_person='..tostring(camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson))
 print('VilverinContinue potion stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x9847f))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' magicka='..Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current..' fatigue='..Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self).current..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
end}}}}
